sessions.phase_label: Concept design, detailed floor-plan development, and iterative revision

requirements.title: Three-Unit Dwelling Configuration
requirements.definition: Subdivide the existing residence into three independent dwellings with the client-confirmed unit mix, including a 2+1 configuration for unit 1.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the number and room-type composition of the dwellings; wall geometry, kitchens, bathrooms, and entrance-door topology remain independently evolving Requirements.

requirements.title: Partition Wall Layout
requirements.definition: Define the walls to preserve, demolish, construct, or reposition while reusing the existing wall structure as much as practical.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats the coordinated partition plan as one mechanism; circulation-space objectives and ownership of the common vestibule area are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Corridor Space Optimization
requirements.definition: Avoid or productively use excessive corridor space, including narrowing the corridor by moving the adjacent room wall by 28 cm.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the independently discussed corridor-width and utilization objective rather than all partition-wall geometry.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Entry-Area Allocation
requirements.definition: Determine how the WC-adjacent or 6.8-square-meter common vestibule area is incorporated into and used by unit 1.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns allocation and intended use of the entry-area space; the walls implementing that allocation belong to the partition-wall Requirement.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Kitchen Layout
requirements.definition: Provide unit 1 with an open-concept kitchen and the required cabinet arrangement while maintaining a practical relationship with its common bathroom.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from the other kitchens because the proposed unit 1 kitchen and bathroom swap has its own decision trajectory.

requirements.title: Unit 2 Kitchen Layout
requirements.definition: Provide unit 2 with an open-concept kitchen using the client-specified upper and lower cabinet arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Retained as a sparse independent Requirement because each dwelling's kitchen can be revised without changing the other units.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Kitchen Layout
requirements.definition: Provide unit 3 with an open-concept kitchen and a cabinet/counter position that fits without obstructing the bathroom door.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated because unit 3 receives a distinct counter-placement and bathroom-door-clearance discussion.

requirements.title: Bathroom Drainage Alignment
requirements.definition: Position bathroom toilets, drains, and related fixtures with respect to the existing waste-pipe locations and feasible plumbing connections.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the cross-unit plumbing constraint; unit-specific fixture geometry and door arrangements remain under their respective bathroom Requirements.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Common Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Define a usable common bathroom for unit 1, including its location relative to the kitchen and placement of the toilet, sink, and shower.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from the unit 1 ensuite because the two bathrooms have different purposes, fixture arrangements, and modification trajectories.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Ensuite Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Create a second independent bathroom associated with the unit 1 bedroom and arrange its enclosure, door, and fixtures within available space.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the independently introduced ensuite mechanism, including the later fixture-fit conflict, rather than all unit 1 bathroom behavior.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Bathroom Door and Clearance
requirements.definition: Select and orient the unit 1 bathroom door so that it does not collide with bathroom fixtures or the apartment entrance door.
requirements.boundary_note: Door type, swing direction, and collision clearance can be changed independently of the bathroom's broader fixture layout.

requirements.title: Unit 2 Bathroom Layout
requirements.definition: Provide a usable bathroom for unit 2, including the requested positioning of its bathroom door.
requirements.boundary_note: Retained as an independent sparse Requirement because unit 2's bathroom and door can be revised without affecting the other bathrooms.

requirements.title: Common and Independent Entrance Layout
requirements.definition: Retain the existing common steel entrance door and provide each dwelling with its own independent steel entrance door without impractical door conflicts.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats the shared-door and private-door topology as one access mechanism; bathroom doors are excluded.

requirements.title: Exterior Window Preservation
requirements.definition: Preserve the existing exterior facade windows in the redesigned floor plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Window preservation can remain unchanged even if the balcony enclosure decision changes.

requirements.title: Balcony Treatment
requirements.definition: Keep the existing balcony open unless enclosing it into the adjacent room provides a meaningful spatial benefit.
requirements.boundary_note: The balcony enclosure decision is independently changeable and is not an attribute of exterior-window preservation.

requirements.title: Initial Concept Sketch
requirements.definition: Provide a simple initial sketch showing the proposed three bathrooms, three kitchen cabinets, separation walls, and dwelling division.
requirements.boundary_note: This lightweight first-draft artifact is independently requested and distinct from the later detailed digital plan.

requirements.title: Detailed AutoCAD Plan
requirements.definition: Produce a refined digital floor plan in AutoCAD after the initial concept stage.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the detailed digital-plan artifact and format, not the initial sketch, plan annotations, or furnished overlay.

requirements.title: Plan Dimension Annotations
requirements.definition: Annotate the plan with requested room, wall, bathroom, fixture, door-offset, and clearance dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: All requested measurement labels are attributes of one documentation mechanism; physical fit and layout correctness remain under the corresponding spatial Requirements.

requirements.title: Furnished Layout Drawing
requirements.definition: Provide a separate plan drawing showing representative furniture and appliances, including seating, televisions, beds, wardrobes, and refrigerators.
requirements.boundary_note: The furnished overlay is an independently requested deliverable rather than part of the physical kitchen or bathroom configuration.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Bathroom Fixture and Spatial Layout
requirements.definition: Define unit 3 bathroom width, door position, fixture placement, shower location, washing-machine location, and drainage-facing arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: The width and fixture positions form one tightly coupled spatial mechanism for unit 3; plan-label dimensions belong to the separate documentation Requirement.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Bathroom Door and Clearance
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

Several uses are proposed for the additional unit 1 entry area, but no unambiguous final selection among the alternatives is visible.

source_message.text: Çizime oda ölçülerini de ekleyebilir misiniz? Ayrıca banyolardaki tuvalet konumlarını, mevcut giderlerde sorun yaratmayacak biçimde güncelleyebilir misiniz? / No2 banyo kapısını banyonun ortasına konumlandırmak mümkün mü? / Koltuk, tv, yatak, gardrop ve benzeri oda eşyalarını da ayrı bir drawing olarak plana ekleyebilir misiniz?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Tezgah tarafı boş kalacak şekilde mor duvarları kaldıralım. Mavi işaretli koridor gereğinden fazla genişledi; bu alanı nasıl değerlendirebiliriz? Buzdolaplarını da plana ekleyebilir misin?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: A simple pencil drawing will be enough to communicate the general idea, so please do not spend too much time on the first draft. Could you indicate the positions of the 3 new bathrooms, the 3 new kitchen cabinets, and the separation walls, including how you would divide the houses?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Koridoru daraltmak amacıyla odanın duvarını 28cm daha kaydırabilir misiniz? Ayrıca no3 banyosunun giderini ve duşunu sol duvara almanızı rica ediyorum; bu değişiklikler tamamlandıktan sonra onay verebilirim.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Kırmızı duvarları kaldırıp mutfak tezgahlarını sarı alanlara alsak ölçüler kurtarıyor mu? Tezgahı engellememesi için banyo kapısını mavi konuma alabiliriz. / 3 nolu evin giriş kapısını mavi işaretli yere alsak? / Balkonu odaya dahil etmezsek oda fazla küçük kalır mı? / Turkuaz duvarları ekleyerek wc alanını 1 nolu eve katabilir miyiz? Ayrıca çelik kapının koridor başında olması, yan evin çelik kapısıyla sorun yaratır mı?
